description: This file defines the TalkAudioPlayer class, which manages audio playback functionality using AVFoundation's AVAudioPlayer. It includes methods for playing audio data, stopping playback, and internal handling of the playback lifecycle, including watchdog timers and state management. It also defines a result struct for indicating playback completion status.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer
classes.description: Singleton class managing audio playback, handling start, stop, and internal lifecycle events for audio data playback.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer.Playback
classes.description: Internal class to handle playback state, continuation, and watchdog timer management during audio playback.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Asynchronously plays audio data provided as a Data object and returns a TalkPlaybackResult indicating success or failure.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops current playback and returns the current time at which the playback was interrupted, if any.

methods.name: audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying
methods.description: Delegate method called when audio playback finishes successfully or due to interruption.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Internal method to stop playback and update internal state.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the playback process, resumes any waiting continuation, and resets internal state.

methods.name: armWatchdog
methods.description: Sets up a watchdog timer to monitor playback health and handle timeout or failure scenarios.

methods.name: setContinuation
methods.description: Sets the continuation object for the current playback operation.

methods.name: setWatchdog
methods.description: Assigns a watchdog task to monitor playback timeout.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks the playback as finished with a specific result and resumes any awaiting continuation.
